correctness.rationale: Any comma-free binary word of length 6 must be primitive and no two representatives of one rotation class can coexist. Möbius inversion counts 54 primitive words and exactly nine primitive necklaces, bounding code size by nine. Independently enumerated all nine-necklace transversals with monotone pruning of already-forbidden overlaps; the verifier checked all ordered pairs and shifts for each chosen candidate, counted 1972 size-nine codebooks and exhibited the claimed lexicographic first. All 1972 codes remain compatible under complement and reversal; the generated four-element orbits comprise exactly 493 size-four classes. Completeness follows from the nine independent primitive-necklace choices, not a guessed partial enumeration.
